More Than a Vendor

We Go Beyond the Service Call

Most pest control companies show up, spray, and leave. EnviroCare thinks differently. When you partner with us on new construction, you're getting a team that takes ownership of the long-term outcome — for you and for your homeowners.

We coordinate with your construction timeline. We're on site when we need to be. We document everything. And when your homeowner needs help two years later, we're still here — your customer is our customer, and we treat them that way.

That's what 68+ years of Alabama builder relationships looks like. Trust built on showing up, doing it right, and staying committed.

What We Do for Builders

From groundbreaking to move-in and beyond

Before slab pour

Pre-Construction Soil Treatment

Termiticide applied to the soil under and around the foundation before concrete is poured. The most effective and comprehensive method of termite prevention for new homes.

At framing or move-in

Sentricon® System Installation

Certified Sentricon Specialists install bait stations around the completed home's perimeter. Provides ongoing, always-active monitoring and colony elimination from day one.

During build

Construction Phase Pest Control

Open construction creates pest entry points. We manage pest pressure during the build to protect materials, prevent harborage, and keep job sites clean.

At closing

Homeowner Onboarding

We meet with new homeowners to explain their protection system, answer questions, and set up their annual monitoring account. Your buyers feel taken care of — because they are.

Delivered at closing

Warranty & Documentation

Full documentation of all treatments, warranty coverage, and service history provided to the homeowner at closing. Clean records for your legal protection too.

Year 1 and beyond

Ongoing Annual Monitoring

Homeowners transition into EnviroCare's annual Sentricon monitoring plan. We keep protecting your homes long after you've moved on to the next project.
